description: This file defines the SeoContentDriver class, which manages SEO-related metadata and tags for content items in an OrchardCore CMS module. It processes SEO aspects, sets page titles, and registers meta tags for OpenGraph, Twitter, and JSON-LD schemas.

classes.name: SeoContentDriver
classes.description: A driver class for managing SEO metadata and tags for content items in OrchardCore.

methods.name: SeoContentDriver
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for SEO content processing.

methods.name: DisplayAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a content item to set SEO metadata, including titles, meta tags, OpenGraph, Twitter cards, and JSON-LD schemas.
